set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test -S "$P/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import socket,json
p="/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
req={"request_id":"search-menu-layout-20261114","action":"bot_start_menu"}
with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
 s.settimeout(25)
 s.connect(p)
 s.sendall((json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode())
 out=b""
 while not out.endswith(b"\n"):
  part=s.recv(8192)
  if not part:raise RuntimeError("USERBOT_IPC_CLOSED")
  out+=part
 result=json.loads(out)
 if result.get("status")!="PASS" or result.get("menu_matches_contract") is not True or result.get("row_sizes") != [3,2,2,3]:
  raise RuntimeError("USERBOT_POSTING_MENU_LAYOUT_FAILED")
 print("USERBOT_10_BUTTON_SEARCH_VISIBLE_PASS")
PY
